passage.title: Restricted Fishing Area
passage.body:
Área de Preservação Ambiental
Proibida a pesca. Multa de R$ 500,00.
Proibido o uso de redes e apetrechos.
Respeite a natureza e a vida aquática.

items.stem: What does the word "proibido" mean here?
items.explanation: The word "proibido" means "forbidden" here, as it is used to indicate that fishing is not allowed in this area. The sign states: "Pesca proibida. Multa de R$ 500,00".

items.stem: What is the main purpose of this sign?
choices: To inform about a fishing competition
To advertise a new fishing spot
items.explanation: The main purpose of this sign is "to warn about forbidden fishing". The sign clearly states "Pesca proibida" (Fishing forbidden) and mentions a fine for violating this rule.

passage.title: Hotel Reservation Issue

Hotel das Montanhas

ATENÇÃO: Sua reserva não foi encontrada. Verifique os dados e tente novamente. Obrigado.

items.stem: What is the name of the hotel where the problem occurred?
items.explanation: The name of the hotel is clearly stated as **Hotel das Montanhas** in the text.

items.stem: The phrase **'reserva não encontrada'** means here that
choices: the reservation was not made correctly
items.explanation: The phrase **'reserva não encontrada'** indicates that the reservation was not found or made correctly, as stated in the text.

passage.title: Emergency Shelter
passage.body: Socorro de emergência após terremoto. Este abrigo está aberto a todos os afetados pelo terremoto. Ajudamos com água, comida e cobertores. Por favor, traga seus documentos de identificação. Agradecemos pela cooperação. Abrigado, seguro e alimentado.

items.stem: What is the sign's main message?
choices: The shelter is open to all people affected by the earthquake.
Food will be provided for three days.
People may stay here only for two days.
items.explanation: The sign states that the shelter is open to all people affected by the earthquake, using the phrases 'aberto a todos afetados pelo terremoto' (open to all affected by the earthquake) and 'socorro de emergência' (emergency aid). It does not mention any restrictions on the duration of stay or the provision of food for three days.

passage.title: Water Supply Disruption
passage.body: Saneamento Fluminense informa que, devido a um ataque cibernético em nosso sistema informatizado, pode haver interrupções no fornecimento de água. Estamos trabalhando para resolver o problema o mais rápido possível. Pedimos desculpas pelo inconveniente e agradecemos sua compreensão.

items.stem: What happened to the computer system at Saneamento Fluminense?
items.explanation: The text states that there was an "ataque cibernético", which means a cyberattack, on the computer system.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of this announcement?
choices: To announce a change in billing procedures.
To alert customers about a disruption in water service.
To inform customers about a scheduled maintenance.
To promote a new water conservation initiative.
items.explanation: The main purpose is to alert customers about a disruption in water service due to a cyberattack, as stated in "Informamos que devido a um ataque cibernético... pode haver interrupções no fornecimento de água."

items.stem: What does the word "interrupções" mean here?
items.explanation: The word "interrupções" means disruptions here, referring to the potential stops in water supply due to the cyberattack.

passage.title: Evacuation Advisory
passage.body: Aviso de inundação iminente! Moradores das áreas baixas do Rio das Pedras, preparem-se para possíveis inundações nas próximas 24 horas. Utilizem este tempo para reunir suprimentos de emergência, como água, alimentos e remédios. Levem seus animais de estimação com vocês. Sigam as orientações das autoridades locais e evacuem para o abrigo designado no Centro Comunitário da Vila Nova, se necessário. Mantenham-se informados sobre as últimas notícias e orientações. Fiquem a salvo!

items.stem: In the notice, what should people do with their pets?
choices: Bring them to the evacuation shelter.
Take them to a neighbor's house.
items.explanation: The notice states 'Leve seus animais de estimação com você' ('Take your pets with you').

items.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?
choices: To inform residents about a community event.
To advise residents to prepare for a flood.
To announce a change in local regulations.
items.explanation: The main purpose is to advise residents to prepare for a flood, as indicated by 'Aviso de inundação iminente' ('Imminent flood warning') and instructions to gather supplies and evacuate.

items.stem: What is the purpose of the phrase 'Mantenha-se informado' in the notice?
choices: To remind residents to stay updated on the situation.
To encourage residents to watch television.
To suggest residents call a hotline.
To promote a local news outlet.
items.explanation: The phrase 'Mantenha-se informado' ('Stay informed') reminds residents to stay updated on the situation, as it is followed by 'sobre as últimas notícias e instruções' ('about the latest news and instructions').

passage.title: Preparing for Summer
passage.body:
Prefeitura Municipal

Aviso aos Moradores

Devido à escassez de chuva, estamos enfrentando uma falta de água. Para ajudar a economizar, siga estas dicas:

- Tome banhos mais curtos.
- Feche a torneira enquanto escova os dentes.
- Use a máquina de lavar roupas apenas quando estiver cheia.

Agradecemos sua colaboração.

Prefeitura Municipal

items.stem: What is the main reason for the water shortage according to the notice?
choices: The water treatment plant is closed.
People are using too much water.
items.explanation: The notice states that the water shortage is due to the lack of rain: “Devido à falta de chuva..”.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?
choices: To announce a water shortage and provide instructions.
To encourage people to take longer showers.
To inform people about a new water park.
To advertise a new water-saving product.
items.explanation: The main purpose of the notice is to announce the water shortage and provide instructions on how to conserve water: “Devido à falta de chuva, estamos enfrentando uma escassez de água... Siga estas dicas para economizar água.”.

passage.title: International Education Conference
passage.body:
Conferência Internacional de Educação

Você está convidado a participar da Conferência Internacional de Educação, que acontecerá em São Paulo, Brasil, de 15 a 17 de março. O evento tem como objetivo compartilhar conhecimentos e experiências na área da educação. Todos os educadores interessados estão convidados a participar. A conferência será realizada no Centro de Convenções Reunions São Paulo. Mais informações em breve. Não perca essa oportunidade de aprender e fazer networking com educadores de todo o mundo!

items.stem: What is the purpose of the conference?
choices: To discuss political issues between countries
To teach new languages to attendees
To share knowledge and experiences in education
items.explanation: The text states that the purpose of the conference is 'para compartilhar conhecimentos e experiências em educação' (to share knowledge and experiences in education). The other options are not mentioned in the text.

items.stem: What is the main idea of the announcement?
choices: Attendees should bring their own lunch
The conference is about education and will be held in Brazil
The conference will take place in Rio de Janeiro
The conference is only for Brazilian educators
items.explanation: The main idea of the announcement is that there is a conference about education that will be held in Brazil. The other options are either not the main idea or not mentioned in the text.

items.stem: What does 'participantes' mean here?
items.explanation: The word 'participantes' in the text refers to those who will be attending the conference, which is 'todos os educadores interessados' (all interested educators). Therefore, the correct answer is 'Attendees'.

passage.title: Port Visit Announcement
passage.body: Atenção, moradores! O navio Niterói estará atracado no porto amanhã. A tripulação visitará a cidade e participará de eventos culturais. Apresente-se no cais principal para dar as boas-vindas aos marinheiros. Não perca essa oportunidade única!

items.stem: What is the name of the ship visiting the port?
items.explanation: The correct answer is Niterói. The text states: 'O navio Niterói estará atracado no porto amanhã.' This indicates that the ship's name is Niterói.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of the text?
choices: To inform about a ship's arrival
items.explanation: The correct answer is to inform about a ship's arrival. The text mentions: 'O navio Niterói estará atracado no porto amanhã.' This is the main purpose of the text.

items.stem: What does the word 'atracado' mean here?
items.explanation: The correct answer is docked. The text says: 'O navio Niterói estará atracado no porto amanhã.' This means the ship will be docked at the port tomorrow.
